items: Each difference is Confirmed Functional Mismatch (contradicts approved Test Data or a requirement), Pending Parity Clarification (genuine business difference, expected behaviour not established), or Representation Only (equivalent meaning).
P-UPSELL, P-AIRPORT and P-CEILING are known Pending mechanisms, not an exhaustive list.
Search modifiers (ReturnUpsellFare, PreferCity, AllowDirectAccess, CurrencyType, …) are documented in A10 with both values and evidence. They are never classified as defects just because they differ.
Request (A3–A11) and Response (A12–A20) groups get separate outcomes. Passed only with no Confirmed and no Pending differences.
Nothing is judged at the Integration Layer → Galileo boundary (BND-03). It is not observable.

DI-1: Outcome classes for this run: Confirmed Functional Mismatch (contradicts approved Test Data or an approved requirement), Pending Parity Clarification (a genuine business difference whose expected behaviour is not established), Representation Only (equivalent business meaning). P-UPSELL, P-AIRPORT and P-CEILING are known mechanisms, not an exhaustive list. Decision: Decided by Ahmed Ayman, 2026-10-11: accepted as test-design rules for this run. No Project Context rev 4.
DI-2: P-CEILING: one side returned exactly 200 solutions. That does not prove truncation. Decision: Decided: stays Pending Parity Clarification.

DI-3: A case with no failed assertion but unresolved Pending items. Checked against the Run Manager (executionHistory.buildHistory) with a scratchpad fixture: a recorded Inconclusive with verified assertions stays Inconclusive, with no conflict. A separate group-outcome table is not read as a results or assertion table. Limitation: the Run Manager has no structured "Pending" status, so the reason is free text and PC IDs live in the QA Report. Decision: Decided: no forced Passed or Failed. Recorded as Inconclusive with a "Pending Parity Clarification:" reason, a group-outcome table, and PC IDs in the QA Report. A structured status would need a platform change (not proposed for now).

DI-4: TC-GCSP-021: Check Supplier may produce no request for a partial Multi-City RBD. Decision: Decided: capture the evidence, record A2–A20 as Not checked and the case as Inconclusive, and infer no value.
DI-5: 24 Check Supplier calls per branch (48 in total). Decision: Decided: acceptable, subject to the execution preflight and a Headed/Headless confirmation.
